translations.idiomatic: When a guest star transgresses it, war arises, the people flee, fires break out, flood and drought afflict the land, and famine follows.

translations.literal: When a comet or broom star encroaches upon it, war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet or broom star transgresses it, war and mourning follow.

translations.literal: When a meteor encroaches upon it, the chancellor and historiographers are dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor transgresses it, the chancellor and historiographers are dismissed.

translations.literal: When cloud vapor encroaches upon it in yellow-white, officials throughout the bureaucracy receive gifts;
translations.idiomatic: When yellow-white cloud vapor transgresses it, officials throughout the bureaucracy receive gifts;

translations.literal: red portends drought and war;
translations.idiomatic: red portends drought and war;

translations.literal: pale vapor — widespread pestilence among the people.
translations.idiomatic: pale vapor means widespread pestilence among the people.

translations.literal: Celestial Spear: three stars, east of the Dipper's ladle.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Spear comprises three stars east of the Dipper's ladle.

sentences.zh: 一曰天鉞，天之武備也，故在紫微宮左右，所以禦難也。

translations.literal: Also called the Celestial Battle-axe — the celestial armory. Therefore it stands on either side of the Purple Palace to ward off adversity.
translations.idiomatic: Also called the Celestial Battle-axe—the celestial armory. Therefore it stands on either side of the Purple Palace to ward off adversity.

translations.literal: When bright, auspicious;
translations.idiomatic: When bright, the omen is auspicious;

translations.literal: when dim and small, armies suffer defeat;
translations.idiomatic: when dim and small, armies suffer defeat;

translations.literal: when its rays and horns shift, war arises.
translations.idiomatic: when its rays and horns shift, war arises.

sentences.zh: 客星、彗星、流星犯，皆爲兵、饑。

translations.literal: When a guest star, comet, or meteor encroaches upon them, all portend war and famine.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star, comet, or meteor transgresses them, all portend war and famine.

sentences.zh: 天棓五星，在女床北，天子先驅也，主分爭與刑罰藏兵，亦所以禦難，備非常也。

translations.literal: Celestial Club: five stars north of the Woman's Couch — the vanguard of the Son of Heaven. It governs contention, punishment, and the storing of arms, also to ward off adversity and prepare for the unexpected.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Club comprises five stars north of the Woman's Couch—the vanguard of the Son of Heaven. It governs contention, punishment, and the storing of arms, and also wards off adversity and prepares for the unexpected.

translations.literal: When one star is incomplete, war arises in that kingdom;
translations.idiomatic: When one star is incomplete, war arises in that kingdom;

translations.literal: when bright, trouble is at hand;
translations.idiomatic: when bright, trouble is at hand;

translations.literal: when fine and faint, auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: when fine and faint, the omen is auspicious.

translations.literal: When a guest star enters, war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star enters, war and mourning follow.

translations.literal: When a comet stations itself there, war arises.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet stations itself there, war arises.

translations.literal: When a meteor encroaches upon them, feudal lords quarrel in many places.
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor transgresses them, feudal lords quarrel far and wide.

translations.literal: When cloud vapor encroaches upon them in pale or black, disaster.
translations.idiomatic: When pale or black cloud vapor transgresses them, calamity follows.

sentences.zh: 天戈一星，又名玄戈，在招搖北，主北方。

translations.literal: Celestial Halberd: a single star, also called the Dark Halberd, north of the Brandish — it governs the north.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Halberd is a single star, also called the Dark Halberd, north of the Brandish. It governs the north.

translations.literal: When its rays and horns waver, northern armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: When its rays and horns waver, northern armies rise.

translations.literal: When a guest star stations itself there, northern armies are defeated.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star stations itself there, northern armies are defeated.

translations.literal: When a comet, broom star, or meteor encroaches upon it, the reading is the same.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet, broom star, or meteor transgresses it, the reading is the same.

translations.literal: When cloud vapor encroaches upon it in black, northern armies retreat;
translations.idiomatic: When black cloud vapor transgresses it, northern armies retreat;

translations.literal: pale vapor — illness among northerners.
translations.idiomatic: pale vapor means illness among northerners.

sentences.zh: 太尊一星，在中臺北，貴戚也。

translations.literal: Grand Honor: a single star north of the Central Terrace — the noble relations of the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Honor is a single star north of the Central Terrace—the noble kinsmen of the throne.

translations.literal: When it cannot be seen, trouble.
translations.idiomatic: When it cannot be seen, trouble follows.

sentences.zh: 客、彗、流星犯之，並爲貴戚將敗之徵。

translations.literal: When a guest star, comet, or meteor encroaches upon it, all alike portend the imminent fall of noble kinsmen.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star, comet, or meteor transgresses it, all alike portend the imminent fall of noble kinsmen.

sentences.zh: 按《步天歌》載，中宮紫微垣經星常宿可名者三十五坐，積數一百六十有四。

translations.literal: According to the Song of Pacing Heaven, within the Central Palace Purple Forbidden Enclosure there are thirty-five named regular asterisms, totaling one hundred sixty-four stars.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Song of Pacing Heaven, within the Central Palace Purple Forbidden Enclosure there are thirty-five named regular asterisms, totaling one hundred sixty-four stars.

sentences.zh: 而《晉志》所載太尊、天戈、天槍、天棓皆屬太微垣，八穀八星在天市垣，與《步天歌》不同。

translations.literal: Yet the Jin Treatise places Grand Honor, Celestial Halberd, Celestial Spear, and Celestial Club all within the Supreme Palace Enclosure, and the Eight Grains' eight stars within the Celestial Market Enclosure — differing from the Song of Pacing Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Jin Treatise places Grand Honor, Celestial Halberd, Celestial Spear, and Celestial Club all within the Supreme Palace Enclosure, and the Eight Grains' eight stars within the Celestial Market Enclosure—differing from the Song of Pacing Heaven.

translations.literal: The Supreme Palace Enclosure
translations.idiomatic: The Supreme Palace Enclosure

sentences.zh: 太微垣十星，《漢志》曰：「南宮朱鳥，權、衡。

translations.literal: The Supreme Palace Enclosure comprises ten stars. The Han Treatise says: 'The Vermilion Bird of the Southern Palace — Balance and Scales.'
translations.idiomatic: The Supreme Palace Enclosure comprises ten stars. The Han Treatise says: 'The Vermilion Bird of the Southern Palace—Balance and Scales.'

sentences.zh: 」《晉志》曰：「天子庭也，五帝之坐也，十二諸侯之府也。

translations.literal: The Jin Treatise says: 'The court of the Son of Heaven, the seat of the Five Emperors, the offices of the twelve feudal lords.'
translations.idiomatic: The Jin Treatise says: 'The court of the Son of Heaven, the seat of the Five Emperors, the offices of the twelve feudal lords.'

translations.literal: Its outer ramparts represent the Nine Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Its outer ramparts represent the Nine Ministers.

sentences.zh: 一曰太微爲衡，衡主平也；

translations.literal: It is also said that the Supreme Palace is the Scales, and the Scales govern equity;
translations.idiomatic: It is also said that the Supreme Palace is the Scales, and the Scales govern equity;

sentences.zh: 又爲天庭，理法平辭，監升授德，列宿受符，諸神考節，舒情稽疑也。

translations.literal: it is also the Celestial Court, where law is weighed and words balanced, promotions are overseen and virtue bestowed, the ordered stars receive their mandates, the spirits examine the seasons, feelings are expressed and doubts examined.
translations.idiomatic: it is also the Celestial Court, where law is weighed and words balanced, promotions are overseen and virtue bestowed, the ordered stars receive their mandates, the spirits examine the seasons, feelings are expressed and doubts examined.

translations.literal: Between the two stars at the center of the southern rampart lies the Upright Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Between the two stars at the center of the southern rampart lies the Upright Gate.

translations.literal: To the east is the Left Enforcer — the image of the Commandant of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is the Left Enforcer—the image of the Commandant of Justice.

sentences.zh: 西曰右執法，御史大夫之象。

translations.literal: To the west is the Right Enforcer — the image of the Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Right Enforcer—the image of the Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: The Enforcers exist to expose and impeach wickedness.
translations.idiomatic: The Enforcers exist to expose and impeach wickedness.

translations.literal: East of the Left Enforcer lies the Left Side Gate.
translations.idiomatic: East of the Left Enforcer lies the Left Side Gate.

translations.literal: West of the Right Enforcer lies the Right Side Gate.
translations.idiomatic: West of the Right Enforcer lies the Right Side Gate.

sentences.zh: 東蕃四星：南第一曰上相，其北，東太陽門也；

translations.literal: The eastern rampart's four stars: the southernmost is called the Chief Minister; north of it lies the Eastern Gate of the Great Yang;
translations.idiomatic: The eastern rampart's four stars: the southernmost is called the Chief Minister; north of it lies the Eastern Gate of the Great Yang;

sentences.zh: 第二曰次相，其北，中華東門也；

translations.literal: the second is called the Second Minister; north of it lies the Eastern Gate of Central Splendor;
translations.idiomatic: the second is called the Second Minister; north of it lies the Eastern Gate of Central Splendor;

sentences.zh: 第三曰次將，其北，東太陰門也；

translations.literal: the third is called the Second General; north of it lies the Eastern Gate of the Great Yin;
translations.idiomatic: the third is called the Second General; north of it lies the Eastern Gate of the Great Yin;

sentences.zh: 第四曰上將，所謂四輔也。

translations.literal: the fourth is called the Chief General — the so-called Four Assistants.
translations.idiomatic: the fourth is called the Chief General—the so-called Four Assistants.

sentences.zh: 西蕃四星：南第一曰上將，其北，西太陽門也；

translations.literal: The western rampart's four stars: the southernmost is called the Chief General; north of it lies the Western Gate of the Great Yang;
translations.idiomatic: The western rampart's four stars: the southernmost is called the Chief General; north of it lies the Western Gate of the Great Yang;

sentences.zh: 第二曰次將，其北，中華西門也；

translations.literal: the second is called the Second General; north of it lies the Western Gate of Central Splendor;
translations.idiomatic: the second is called the Second General; north of it lies the Western Gate of Central Splendor;

sentences.zh: 第三曰次相，其北，西太陰門也；

translations.literal: the third is called the Second Minister; north of it lies the Western Gate of the Great Yin;
translations.idiomatic: the third is called the Second Minister; north of it lies the Western Gate of the Great Yin;

sentences.zh: 第四曰上相，亦曰四輔也。

translations.literal: the fourth is called the Chief Minister — also called the Four Assistants.
translations.idiomatic: the fourth is called the Chief Minister—also called the Four Assistants.

translations.literal: The Han Treatise: 'Twelve stars in circlet guard — the rampart ministers: west, generals;
translations.idiomatic: The Han Treatise: 'Twelve stars in circlet guard—the rampart ministers: west, generals;

translations.literal: east, ministers;
translations.idiomatic: east, ministers;

translations.literal: the four southern stars, the Enforcers;
translations.idiomatic: the four southern stars, the Enforcers;

translations.literal: at the center, the Upright Gate;
translations.idiomatic: at the center, the Upright Gate;

translations.literal: to left and right, the Side Gates.'
translations.idiomatic: to left and right, the Side Gates.'

sentences.zh: 」《乾象新書》：十星，東西各五，在翼、軫北。

translations.literal: The New Book of Heavenly Images: ten stars, five east and five west, north of Wings and Chariot Axle.
translations.idiomatic: The New Book of Heavenly Images: ten stars, five east and five west, north of Wings and Chariot Axle.

sentences.zh: 其西蕃北星爲上相，南門右星爲右執法。

translations.literal: The northern star of the western rampart is the Chief Minister; the right star of the southern gate is the Right Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: The northern star of the western rampart is the Chief Minister; the right star of the southern gate is the Right Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 東西蕃有芒及動搖者，諸侯謀上。

translations.literal: When either eastern or western rampart shows rays or shifting, feudal lords plot against the sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: When either eastern or western rampart shows rays or shifting, feudal lords plot against the sovereign.

translations.literal: When the Enforcers shift position, punishments grow especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: When the Enforcers shift position, punishments grow especially severe.

translations.literal: When the Moon or the Five Planets enter the orbit of the Supreme Palace, auspicious;
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon or the Five Planets enter the orbit of the Supreme Palace, the omen is auspicious;

translations.literal: the celestial seat they transgress signifies completed punishment.
translations.idiomatic: the celestial seat they transgress signifies completed punishment.

sentences.zh: 月犯太微垣，輔臣惡之，又君弱臣強，四方兵不制；

translations.literal: When the Moon transgresses the Supreme Palace Enclosure, the aides take it as ill omen; moreover the ruler grows weak and ministers strong, and armies in the four quarters run beyond control;
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon transgresses the Supreme Palace Enclosure, the aides take it as ill omen; moreover the ruler grows weak and ministers strong, and armies in the four quarters run beyond control;

sentences.zh: 犯執法，《海中占》云：「將相有免者期三年。

translations.literal: transgressing the Enforcers — the Treatise of the Central Sea says: 'Among generals and ministers, some will be dismissed within three years.'
translations.idiomatic: transgressing the Enforcers—the Treatise of the Central Sea says: 'Among generals and ministers, some will be dismissed within three years.'

sentences.zh: 」月入東西門、左右掖門，而南出端門，有叛臣，君憂；

translations.literal: When the Moon enters the eastern or western gates or the left or right Side Gates, then passes south through the Upright Gate, a rebellious minister appears and the sovereign is troubled;
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon enters the eastern or western gates or the left or right Side Gates, then passes south through the Upright Gate, a rebellious minister appears and the sovereign is troubled;

sentences.zh: 入西門，出東門，君憂，大臣假主威。

translations.literal: entering the western gate and exiting the eastern, the sovereign is troubled and great ministers borrow the ruler's authority.
translations.idiomatic: entering the western gate and exiting the eastern, the sovereign is troubled and great ministers borrow the ruler's authority.

sentences.zh: 月中犯乘守四輔，爲臣失禮，輔臣有誅。

translations.literal: When the Moon in its course transgresses or stations itself upon the Four Assistants, ministers are guilty of impropriety and aide-ministers face execution.
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon in its course transgresses or stations itself upon the Four Assistants, ministers are guilty of impropriety and aide-ministers face execution.

translations.literal: When the Moon is halated, the Son of Heaven arms himself for protection.
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon is halated, the Son of Heaven arms himself for protection.

translations.literal: Three halations of the Supreme Palace within one month — a general amnesty follows.
translations.idiomatic: Three halations of the Supreme Palace within one month—a general amnesty follows.

sentences.zh: 月食太微，大臣憂，王者惡之。

translations.literal: A lunar eclipse of the Supreme Palace means anxiety among high ministers and ill omen for the king.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse of the Supreme Palace means anxiety among high ministers and ill omen for the king.

translations.literal: When Jupiter enters, amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: When Jupiter enters, amnesty follows;

translations.literal: transgressing it, the Enforcer-ministers are in distress;
translations.idiomatic: transgressing it, the Enforcer-ministers are in distress;

translations.literal: entering the eastern gate, the realm faces urgent war;
translations.idiomatic: entering the eastern gate, the realm faces urgent war;

translations.literal: stationing itself there, generals, ministers, and Enforcer censor-ministers die;
translations.idiomatic: stationing itself there, generals, ministers, and Enforcer censor-ministers die;

translations.literal: entering the Upright Gate and guarding the Celestial Court, great calamity arrives;
translations.idiomatic: entering the Upright Gate and guarding the Celestial Court, great calamity arrives;

translations.literal: entering the southern gate and exiting the eastern, drought;
translations.idiomatic: entering the southern gate and exiting the eastern, drought follows;

sentences.zh: 入南門，逆出西門，國有喪；

translations.literal: entering the southern gate and retrograde exit through the western, mourning within the realm;
translations.idiomatic: entering the southern gate and retrograde exit through the western, mourning within the realm;

sentences.zh: 逆行入東門，出西門，國破亡。

translations.literal: retrograde entry through the eastern gate and exit through the western, the kingdom is destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: retrograde entry through the eastern gate and exit through the western, the kingdom is destroyed.

sentences.zh: 填星、熒惑犯之，逆行入，爲兵、喪；

translations.literal: When Saturn or Mars transgress it and enter retrograde, war and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: When Saturn or Mars transgress it and enter retrograde, war and mourning follow;

translations.literal: transgressing the Chief General, the Chief General is in distress;
translations.idiomatic: transgressing the Chief General, the Chief General is in distress;

sentences.zh: 守端門，國破亡，或三公謀上，有戮臣；

translations.literal: stationing at the Upright Gate, the kingdom is destroyed — or the Three Excellencies plot against the sovereign and a minister is executed;
translations.idiomatic: stationing at the Upright Gate, the kingdom is destroyed—or the Three Excellencies plot against the sovereign and a minister is executed;

sentences.zh: 犯西上將，天子戰于野，上相死；

translations.literal: transgressing the western Chief General, the Son of Heaven battles in the open field and the Chief Minister dies;
translations.idiomatic: transgressing the western Chief General, the Son of Heaven battles in the open field and the Chief Minister dies;

sentences.zh: 入太微，色白無芒，天下饑；

translations.literal: Entering the Supreme Palace, white and without rays, famine across the realm;
translations.idiomatic: Entering the Supreme Palace, white and without rays, famine spreads across the realm;

translations.literal: Retrograde motion not correct — there is a great prison case.
translations.idiomatic: Irregular retrograde motion portends a major trial.

translations.literal: When it transgresses the Supreme Palace gate, the left and right generals die.
translations.idiomatic: When it transgresses the Supreme Palace gate, the left and right generals perish.

sentences.zh: 入天庭在屏星南，出左掖門左將死，右掖門右將死，直出端門無咎；

translations.literal: Entering the Celestial Court south of the Screen stars: exiting the left side-gate, the left general dies; the right side-gate, the right general dies; exiting straight through the End Gate — no blame.
translations.idiomatic: Entering the Celestial Court south of the Screen stars: exit by the left side-gate and the left general dies; by the right side-gate and the right general dies; pass straight out the End Gate and no harm follows.

sentences.zh: 入太微，淩犯、留止，爲兵，入二十日，廷尉當之，留天庭十日有赦；

translations.literal: Entering the Supreme Palace, encroaching and remaining — war; if it remains twenty days, the Court of Justice bears the omen; if it remains in the Celestial Court ten days, there is an amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Entering the Supreme Palace, transgressing and lingering, brings war; linger twenty days and the Court of Justice bears the omen; linger in the Celestial Court ten days and an amnesty follows.

sentences.zh: 犯太微東南陬，歲饑，執法大臣憂；

translations.literal: Transgressing the southeast corner of the Supreme Palace — famine in the year, and the Law Enforcer ministers are troubled.
translations.idiomatic: When it transgresses the southeast corner of the Supreme Palace, famine follows that year and the Law Enforcer ministers are in distress.

translations.literal: Transgressing the Upper Chancellor — great ministers die.
translations.idiomatic: When it transgresses the Upper Chancellor, high ministers die.

sentences.zh: 填星犯入太微，有德令，女主執政。

translations.literal: When the Stationary Star transgresses and enters the Supreme Palace, there is a decree of virtue and the chief consort governs.
translations.idiomatic: When the Stationary Star transgresses and enters the Supreme Palace, a decree of virtue is issued and the empress holds the reins of government.

sentences.zh: 若逆行執法、四輔，守之，有憂；

translations.literal: If in retrograde at the Law Enforcers and Four Assistants it stations itself there, there is worry.
translations.idiomatic: If it retrogrades at the Law Enforcers or Four Assistants and stations itself there, trouble is at hand.

translations.literal: Stationing itself at the Supreme Palace — the state is broken.
translations.idiomatic: When it stations itself at the Supreme Palace, the realm is shattered.

translations.literal: Stationing itself at the western rampart — the king is troubled.
translations.idiomatic: When it stations itself at the western rampart, the sovereign is in distress.

sentences.zh: 太白犯入太微，爲兵，大臣相殺；

translations.literal: When the Great White transgresses and enters the Supreme Palace, there is war and great ministers kill one another.
translations.idiomatic: When Venus transgresses and enters the Supreme Palace, war follows and high ministers turn on one another.

translations.literal: Stationing itself and remaining — war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When it stations itself and lingers, war and mourning follow.

sentences.zh: 與填星犯太微中，王者惡之；

translations.literal: Together with the Stationary Star transgressing the center of the Supreme Palace — the king regards it as ill-omened.
translations.idiomatic: When it transgresses the heart of the Supreme Palace together with the Stationary Star, the sovereign takes it as a dire omen.

sentences.zh: 入右掖門，從端門出，貴人奪勢；

translations.literal: Entering the right side-gate and exiting through the End Gate — nobles lose power.
translations.idiomatic: Entering by the right side-gate and leaving through the End Gate, the great nobles are stripped of power.

translations.literal: Seen by day at the Supreme Palace — the state has war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When it is seen by day at the Supreme Palace, war and mourning afflict the realm.

sentences.zh: 月掩太白於端門外，國受兵。

translations.literal: The Moon occults the Great White outside the End Gate — the state receives war.
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon occults Venus outside the End Gate, the realm is beset by war.

sentences.zh: 辰星犯太微，天子當之，有內亂；

translations.literal: When Mercury transgresses the Supreme Palace, the Son of Heaven bears the omen and there is inner disorder.
translations.idiomatic: When Mercury transgresses the Supreme Palace, the Son of Heaven bears the omen and rebellion stirs within.

translations.literal: Entering the Celestial Court — the inner palace is troubled and there is a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: When it enters the Celestial Court, the inner palace faces calamity and great floods follow.

sentences.zh: 守左右執法，入，兵起，有赦；

translations.literal: Stationing itself at the left and right Law Enforcers and entering — war rises and there is an amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: When it stations itself at the left and right Law Enforcers and enters, war breaks out and an amnesty is granted.

translations.literal: Entering the western gate — disaster in the inner palace and a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: When it enters the western gate, the inner palace suffers disaster and great floods follow.

sentences.zh: 入西門，出東門，爲 兵、喪、水災。

translations.literal: Entering the western gate and exiting the eastern gate — war, mourning, and flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Entering by the western gate and leaving by the eastern, war, mourning, and flood disaster follow.

sentences.zh: 客星犯入太微，色黃白，天子喜；

translations.literal: When a guest star transgresses and enters the Supreme Palace, yellow-white in color — the Son of Heaven rejoices.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star transgresses and enters the Supreme Palace, wan yellow-white in hue, the Son of Heaven rejoices.

translations.literal: Entering and exiting the End Gate — the state has worry.
translations.idiomatic: When it enters and exits the End Gate, the realm faces trouble.

translations.literal: At the left side-gate — drought.
translations.idiomatic: At the left side-gate, drought follows.

translations.literal: At the right side-gate — the state falls into disorder.
translations.idiomatic: At the right side-gate, the realm falls into disorder.

translations.literal: Exiting the Celestial Court — there is a harsh decree and war rises.
translations.idiomatic: When it exits the Celestial Court, harsh edicts are issued and war breaks out.

translations.literal: Entering the Supreme Palace for thirty days — there is an amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: When it enters the Supreme Palace and remains thirty days, an amnesty follows.

translations.literal: Transgressing the Four Assistants — the assistant ministers meet ill fortune.
translations.idiomatic: When it transgresses the Four Assistants, disaster befalls the chief ministers.

translations.literal: When a comet transgresses the Supreme Palace, all under heaven changes.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet transgresses the Supreme Palace, the realm changes hands.

translations.literal: Exiting the Supreme Palace — worry in the palace and fire disaster.
translations.idiomatic: When it exits the Supreme Palace, the palace faces calamity and fire disaster follows.

translations.literal: Transgressing the Law Enforcers — the law enforcers are dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: When it transgresses the Law Enforcers, the justices are removed from office.

translations.literal: Transgressing the Celestial Court — a ruler is established.
translations.idiomatic: When it transgresses the Celestial Court, a new sovereign is enthroned.

sentences.zh: 孛於翼，近太微上將，爲兵、喪；

translations.literal: A broom star at Wings, near the Supreme Palace Upper General — war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When a broom star appears at Wings, near the Supreme Palace Upper General, war and mourning follow.

translations.literal: A broom star at the western rampart — it governs revolution.
translations.idiomatic: When a broom star appears at the western rampart, revolution is at hand.

translations.literal: A broom star at the Five Emperors — the state perishes and the ruler is slain.
translations.idiomatic: When a broom star appears at the Five Emperors, the state falls and the sovereign is killed.

sentences.zh: 流星出太微，大臣有外事；

translations.literal: A meteor issuing from the Supreme Palace — great ministers have external affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor issues from the Supreme Palace, high ministers are drawn into foreign affairs.

sentences.zh: 出南門甚衆，貴人有死者；

translations.literal: Exiting the southern gate in great numbers — nobles have dead.
translations.idiomatic: When many meteors exit the southern gate, nobles among the great die.

translations.literal: Crisscrossing the Supreme Palace — the ruler is weak and the ministers strong.
translations.idiomatic: When it crisscrosses the Supreme Palace, the sovereign weakens and his ministers grow powerful.

sentences.zh: 由端門入翼，光照地有聲，有立王。

translations.literal: Entering Wings through the End Gate — its light shines upon the ground with sound, and a king is established.
translations.idiomatic: Passing from the End Gate into Wings, its light floods the earth with thunderous sound—and a new king is enthroned.

sentences.zh: 雲氣出入，色微青，君失位。

translations.literal: Cloud vapor entering and exiting, color slightly green — the ruler loses position.
translations.idiomatic: When cloud vapor drifts in and out, faintly green in hue, the sovereign loses his throne.

sentences.zh: 青白黑雲氣入左右掖，爲喪；

translations.literal: Green, white, and black cloud vapor entering the left and right flanks — mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When green, white, and black cloud vapor enters the left and right flanks, mourning follows.

translations.literal: Exiting — no blame.
translations.idiomatic: When it exits, no harm follows.

translations.literal: Red vapor entering the eastern side-gate — inner war rises.
translations.idiomatic: When red vapor enters the eastern side-gate, war breaks out within the palace.

sentences.zh: 黃白雲氣入太微垣，人主喜，年壽長。

translations.literal: Yellow-white cloud vapor entering the Supreme Palace Enclosure — the sovereign rejoices and years of life are long.
translations.idiomatic: When yellow-white cloud vapor enters the Supreme Palace Enclosure, the sovereign rejoices and enjoys long life.

sentences.zh: 入左右掖門，天子有德令。

translations.literal: Entering the left and right side-gates — the Son of Heaven has a decree of virtue.
translations.idiomatic: When it enters the left and right side-gates, the Son of Heaven issues a decree of virtue.

sentences.zh: 黑及蒼白氣入，天子憂，出則無咎。

translations.literal: Black and pale white vapor entering — the Son of Heaven is troubled; if it exits, no blame.
translations.idiomatic: When black and ashen vapor enters, the Son of Heaven is in distress; once it exits, no harm follows.

translations.literal: Black vapor like a snake entering the enclosure gate — mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When black vapor like a serpent enters the enclosure gate, mourning follows.

sentences.zh: 內五帝坐五星，內一星在太微中，黃帝坐，含樞紐之神也。

translations.literal: The Inner Five Emperors Seat: five stars; one star within the Supreme Palace is the Yellow Thearch Seat — the numen of Pivot-and-Hinge.
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Five Emperors Seat comprises five stars; one within the Supreme Palace is the Yellow Thearch Seat—the numen of Pivot-and-Hinge.

sentences.zh: 天子動得天度，止得地意，從容中道則明以光，不明則人主當求賢以輔法；

translations.literal: When the Son of Heaven moves he obtains heaven's measure; when he stops he obtains earth's intent; at ease in the middle way he is bright with light — if not bright, the sovereign should seek worthies to assist the law.
translations.idiomatic: When the Son of Heaven moves, he keeps heaven's measure; when he rests, he holds earth's intent; at ease upon the middle way his seat shines bright—if it does not shine, the sovereign must seek worthy men to uphold the law.

translations.literal: Otherwise he loses power.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise power is wrested from him.

sentences.zh: 四帝星夾黃帝坐，四方各去二度。

translations.literal: The Four Thearch stars flank the Yellow Thearch Seat, each direction two degrees apart.
translations.idiomatic: The Four Thearch stars flank the Yellow Thearch Seat, two degrees apart in each direction.

sentences.zh: 東方，蒼帝靈威仰之神也。

translations.literal: In the east — the Azure Thearch, numen of Spirit Awe-Inspiring.
translations.idiomatic: In the east stands the Azure Thearch—the numen Spirit Awe-Inspiring.

sentences.zh: 南方，赤帝赤熛怒之神也。

translations.literal: In the south — the Red Thearch, numen of Red Blaze Fury.
translations.idiomatic: In the south stands the Red Thearch—the numen Red Blaze Fury.

sentences.zh: 西方，白帝白招拒之神也。

translations.literal: In the west — the White Thearch, numen of White Summoning Repelling.
translations.idiomatic: In the west stands the White Thearch—the numen White Summoning Repelling.

sentences.zh: 北方，黑帝葉光紀之神也。

translations.literal: In the north — the Black Thearch, numen of Leaf Light Record.
translations.idiomatic: In the north stands the Black Thearch—the numen Leaf Light Record.

sentences.zh: 黃帝坐明，天子壽，威令行；

translations.literal: When the Yellow Thearch Seat is bright — the Son of Heaven enjoys long life and his awe-inspiring decrees are executed.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yellow Thearch Seat shines bright, the Son of Heaven enjoys long life and his commands carry weight.

translations.literal: If small, the opposite — power lies with the ministers below.
translations.idiomatic: If it dims, the reverse holds—power passes to the ministers below.

translations.literal: If it vanishes, a great man bears the omen.
translations.idiomatic: If it vanishes from sight, a great man bears the omen.

translations.literal: When the Moon exits the seat to the north — calamity is great.
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon passes north of the seat, great calamity follows.

translations.literal: Exiting the seat to the south — calamity is small.
translations.idiomatic: When it passes south of the seat, the calamity is lesser.

translations.literal: Exiting near it — great ministers are executed, or there is famine.
translations.idiomatic: When it passes close by, high ministers are executed—or famine follows.

translations.literal: Transgressing the Yellow Thearch Seat — there are rebellious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: When it transgresses the Yellow Thearch Seat, treason stirs among the ministers.

translations.literal: Reaching the Imperial Seat — there are earthwork affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When it reaches the Imperial Seat, major earthworks are undertaken.

translations.literal: A lunar halo at the Imperial Seat — there is an amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: When a halo rings the Imperial Seat, an amnesty follows.

translations.literal: Prognostication of the Sea Center: when the Moon transgresses the Imperial Seat, the sovereign regards it as ill-omened.
translations.idiomatic: The Prognostication of the Sea Center: when the Moon transgresses the Imperial Seat, the sovereign takes it as a dire omen.

translations.literal: When the Five Planets station themselves at the Yellow Thearch Seat, the great man is troubled.
translations.idiomatic: When the Five Planets station themselves at the Yellow Thearch Seat, the great man is in distress.

translations.literal: When the Sparkling Deluder and the Great White enter, there are powerful ministers.
translations.idiomatic: When Mars and Venus enter, powerful ministers arise.

translations.literal: When the Year Star transgresses, one not rightfully the master is enthroned.
translations.idiomatic: When the Year Star transgresses, a usurper is enthroned.

translations.literal: When the Sparkling Deluder transgresses — military disorder.
translations.idiomatic: When Mars transgresses, military disorder follows.

translations.literal: Entering the Celestial Court and reaching the Imperial Seat — there is an amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: When it enters the Celestial Court and reaches the Imperial Seat, an amnesty follows.

translations.literal: When the Great White enters it — war is in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: When Venus enters it, war erupts within the palace.

sentences.zh: 填逆行，守黃帝坐，亡君之戒。

translations.literal: The Stationary Star in retrograde, stationing itself at the Yellow Thearch Seat — a warning of a perishing ruler.
translations.idiomatic: When the Stationary Star retrogrades and stations itself at the Yellow Thearch Seat, it warns of a dying sovereign.

translations.literal: When the Five Planets enter, white in color — disorder.
translations.idiomatic: When the Five Planets enter, wan and white in hue, disorder follows.

sentences.zh: 客星色黃白抵帝坐，臣獻美女。

translations.literal: A guest star, yellow-white, reaching the Imperial Seat — a minister presents beautiful women.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star, yellow-white in color, reaches the Imperial Seat, a minister presents beautiful women to the throne.

translations.literal: When a comet enters — palace disorder.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet enters, the palace falls into disorder.

sentences.zh: 抵帝坐，或如粉絮，兵、喪並起。

translations.literal: Reaching the Imperial Seat, or like powder fluff — war and mourning rise together.
translations.idiomatic: When it reaches the Imperial Seat—or spreads like drifting fluff—war and mourning rise together.

translations.literal: When a meteor transgresses it — great ministers are troubled.
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor transgresses it, high ministers are in distress.

sentences.zh: 抵四帝坐，輔臣憂，人多死。

translations.literal: Reaching the Four Thearch Seats — assistant ministers are troubled and many people die.
translations.idiomatic: When it reaches the Four Thearch Seats, the chief ministers are in distress and many perish.

sentences.zh: 蒼白氣抵帝坐，天子有喪；

translations.literal: Pale white vapor reaching the Imperial Seat — the Son of Heaven has mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When pale white vapor reaches the Imperial Seat, mourning falls upon the Son of Heaven.

translations.literal: Green-red — close ministers wish to plot against their master.
translations.idiomatic: Green streaked with red: close ministers plot against their sovereign.

translations.literal: Yellow-white — the Son of Heaven has joy in his descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow-white in hue: the Son of Heaven rejoices in his descendants.

sentences.zh: 月犯四帝，天下有喪，諸侯有憂。

translations.literal: When the Moon transgresses the Four Thearchs — mourning under heaven and feudal lords are troubled.
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon transgresses the Four Thearchs, mourning spreads under heaven and the feudal lords are in distress.

translations.literal: When the Five Planets transgress the Four Thearchs — worry.
translations.idiomatic: When the Five Planets transgress the Four Thearchs, trouble is at hand.

sentences.zh: 太子一星，在帝坐北，帝儲也。

translations.literal: The Heir Apparent: one star north of the Imperial Seat — the imperial heir.
translations.idiomatic: The Heir Apparent is a single star north of the Imperial Seat—the sovereign's chosen successor.

translations.literal: If the heir has virtue, the star is bright and lustrous.
translations.idiomatic: When the heir possesses virtue, the star shines bright and lustrous.

translations.literal: Cloud vapor entering — yellow is joy, black is worry.
translations.idiomatic: When cloud vapor enters, yellow portends joy and black portends trouble.

sentences.zh: 太白、熒惑、客星、流星守、犯，皆爲憂。

translations.literal: The Great White, Sparkling Deluder, guest star, and meteor stationing or transgressing — all are worry.
translations.idiomatic: When Venus, Mars, a guest star, or a meteor stations itself there or transgresses it, trouble follows in every case.

sentences.zh: 一云金、火守之，或入，太子不廢則爲篡逆之事。

translations.literal: One account: Metal and Fire station it or enter — if the Heir Apparent is not deposed, then usurpation follows.
translations.idiomatic: One account holds that when Metal and Fire station it or enter, if the Heir Apparent is not deposed, usurpation follows.

sentences.zh: 內五諸侯五星，在九卿西，內侍天子，不之國也。

translations.literal: The Inner Five Feudal Lords: five stars west of the Nine Ministers — attending the Son of Heaven within, not going to their states.
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Five Feudal Lords comprise five stars west of the Nine Ministers—lords who attend the Son of Heaven at court rather than returning to their fiefs.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》：在郎位南，辟雍禮得，則星明；

translations.literal: New Book of Heavenly Appearances: south of the Official Lodgings — when the Piyong rites are properly observed, the star is bright.
translations.idiomatic: The New Book of Heavenly Appearances: south of the Official Lodgings—when the Piyong rites are properly performed, the star shines bright.

translations.literal: If it vanishes, the feudal lords are dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: If it vanishes from sight, the feudal lords are removed from office.

sentences.zh: 從官一星，在太子北，侍臣也。

translations.literal: The Attendant Official: one star north of the Heir Apparent — attendant ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The Attendant Official is a single star north of the Heir Apparent—the seat of attendant ministers.

sentences.zh: 以不見爲安，一曰不見則帝不安，如常則吉。

translations.literal: Not being seen is peace; one account says not being seen means the emperor is not at ease — as usual is auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Its absence from sight brings peace; one account holds that if it vanishes the emperor grows uneasy—when it appears as usual, fortune follows.

sentences.zh: 幸臣一星，在帝坐東北，常侍太子，以暗爲吉。

translations.literal: The Favored Official: one star northeast of the Imperial Seat, constantly attending the Heir Apparent — dim is auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: The Favored Official is a single star northeast of the Imperial Seat, ever attending the Heir Apparent—a dim star brings good fortune.

sentences.zh: 《新書》：在太子東，青、赤氣入之，近臣謀君不成。

translations.literal: New Book: east of the Heir Apparent — green and red vapor entering it; close ministers plot against the ruler without success.
translations.idiomatic: The New Book: east of the Heir Apparent—when green and red vapor enters, close ministers plot against the sovereign but fail.

sentences.zh: 內屏四星，在端門內，近右執法。

translations.literal: The Inner Screen: four stars within the End Gate, near the Right Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Screen comprises four stars within the End Gate, near the Right Law Enforcer.

translations.literal: The Screen is what shields and covers the imperial court.
translations.idiomatic: The Screen exists to shield and enclose the imperial court.

sentences.zh: 左右執法各一星，在端門兩旁，左爲廷尉之象，右爲御史大夫之象，主舉刺凶奸。

translations.literal: The Left and Right Law Enforcers, each one star on both sides of the End Gate — the left is the image of the Court of Justice, the right the image of the Censor-in-Chief; they govern exposing and impeaching evil traitors.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Law Enforcers are single stars flanking the End Gate—the left embodies the Court of Justice, the right the Censor-in-Chief; together they expose and impeach treachery.

translations.literal: When ruler and ministers observe ritual, they are bright and lustrous.
translations.idiomatic: When ruler and ministers observe proper ritual, the stars shine bright and lustrous.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》：在中台南，明，則法令平。

translations.literal: New Book of Heavenly Appearances: south of the Middle Terrace — when bright, laws and decrees are fair.
translations.idiomatic: The New Book of Heavenly Appearances: south of the Middle Terrace—when bright, laws and decrees are even-handed.

sentences.zh: 月、五星及客星犯守，則君臣失禮、輔臣黜。

translations.literal: When the Moon, Five Planets, and guest star transgress or station themselves there — ruler and ministers lose ritual and assistant ministers are dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon, the Five Planets, or a guest star transgress or station themselves there, ruler and ministers abandon ritual and chief ministers are removed.

translations.literal: When the Sparkling Deluder and Great White enter — war.
translations.idiomatic: When Mars and Venus enter, war follows.

translations.literal: When a meteor transgresses them — the Masters of Writing are troubled.
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor transgresses them, the Masters of Writing are in distress.

sentences.zh: 郎位十五星，在帝坐東北，一曰依烏郎府也。

translations.literal: The Official Lodgings: fifteen stars northeast of the Imperial Seat — also called the Crow-perched Official House.
translations.idiomatic: The Official Lodgings comprise fifteen stars northeast of the Imperial Seat—also called the Crow-perched Official House.

sentences.zh: 周之元士，漢之光祿、中散、諫議、議郎、郎中是其職，主衛守也。

translations.literal: Zhou's primordial scholar-officials; Han's Palace Attendant, Palace Regular, Remonstrance Adviser, Discussion Gentleman, and Palace Gentleman held these offices — they govern guard and defense.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou's primordial scholar-officials; under Han the Palace Attendant, Palace Regular, Remonstrance Adviser, Discussion Gentleman, and Palace Gentleman filled these roles—guarding and defending the throne.

sentences.zh: 其星不具，后妃災，幸臣誅。

translations.literal: If the stars are not complete — disaster for the empress consort and execution of favored officials.
translations.idiomatic: When the stars are incomplete, the empress consort faces calamity and favored officials are executed.

sentences.zh: 星明大，或客星入之，大臣爲亂，元士憂。

translations.literal: Stars bright and large, or a guest star entering them — great ministers rebel and primordial scholar-officials are troubled.
translations.idiomatic: When the stars blaze large and bright, or a guest star enters them, high ministers rebel and the scholar-officials are in distress.

translations.literal: When a comet or broom star transgresses — official lodgers lose power.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet or broom star transgresses them, the court officials lose power.

sentences.zh: 彗星、枉矢出其次，郎佐謀叛。

translations.literal: When a comet or Wayward Arrow emerges from their sequence — official aides plot rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet or Wayward Arrow emerges from their ranks, the officials' aides plot rebellion.

translations.literal: When the Sparkling Deluder stations itself there — war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When Mars stations itself there, war and mourning follow.

translations.literal: Red vapor entering — war rises.
translations.idiomatic: When red vapor enters, war breaks out.

translations.literal: Yellow-white — auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow-white portends good fortune.

translations.literal: Black — inauspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Black portends disaster.

sentences.zh: 郎將一星，在郎位北，主閱具，以爲武備也。

translations.literal: The Official General: one star north of the Official Lodgings — governs inspection of equipment, serving as military readiness.
translations.idiomatic: The Official General is a single star north of the Official Lodgings—overseeing the review of arms and the readiness of the guard.

translations.literal: Like today's Left and Right Central Palace Gentlemen-General.
translations.idiomatic: The counterpart of the Left and Right Central Palace Gentlemen-General.

translations.literal: New Book says: northeast of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: The New Book places it northeast of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

translations.literal: Bright — great ministers rebel.
translations.idiomatic: When bright, high ministers turn traitor.

translations.literal: When a guest star transgresses or stations itself there — the Official General is executed.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star transgresses or stations itself there, the Official General is put to death.

translations.literal: Yellow and white vapor entering — then receiving bestowal.
translations.idiomatic: When yellow or white vapor enters, honors and gifts are bestowed.

translations.literal: When a meteor transgresses — generals are troubled.
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor transgresses it, the generals are in distress.

sentences.zh: 常陳七星，如畢狀，在帝坐北，天子宿衛虎賁之士，以設強禦也。

translations.literal: The Regular Array: seven stars shaped like the Net, north of the Imperial Seat — the Son of Heaven's night-guard tiger-rushing warriors, set for strong defense.
translations.idiomatic: The Regular Array comprises seven stars in the shape of the Net, north of the Imperial Seat—the Son of Heaven's tiger guard, posted for stout defense.

translations.literal: Stars shaking — the Son of Heaven personally leads the army.
translations.idiomatic: When the stars tremble, the Son of Heaven leads the army in person.

translations.literal: Bright — martial weapons are used.
translations.idiomatic: When bright, martial force is deployed.

translations.literal: Faint — weak.
translations.idiomatic: When faint, the guard grows weak.

translations.literal: When a guest star transgresses — the king executes punishments.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star transgresses them, the sovereign metes out executions.

sentences.zh: 九卿三星，在三公北，主治萬事，今九卿之象也。

translations.literal: The Nine Ministers: three stars north of the Three Excellencies — governing the management of all affairs; the image of today's Nine Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Ministers comprise three stars north of the Three Excellencies—overseeing all affairs of state, the celestial image of the Nine Ministers.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》：在內五諸侯南，占與天紀同。

translations.literal: New Book of Heavenly Appearances: south of the Inner Five Feudal Lords — prognostication the same as the Celestial Regulator.
translations.idiomatic: The New Book of Heavenly Appearances: south of the Inner Five Feudal Lords—its prognostications match those of the Celestial Regulator.

sentences.zh: 三公三星，在謁者東北，內坐朝會之所居也。

translations.literal: The Three Excellencies: three stars northeast of the Court Presenter — the inner seat where court assemblies dwell.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Excellencies comprise three stars northeast of the Court Presenter—the inner seat where the court assembles.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》：在九卿南，其占與紫微垣三公同。

translations.literal: New Book of Heavenly Appearances: south of the Nine Ministers — its prognostication the same as the Three Excellencies of the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: The New Book of Heavenly Appearances: south of the Nine Ministers—its prognostications match those of the Three Excellencies in the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 謁者一星，在左執法東北，主贊賓客、辨疑惑。

translations.literal: The Court Presenter: one star northeast of the Left Law Enforcer — governs assisting guests and distinguishing doubts.
translations.idiomatic: The Court Presenter is a single star northeast of the Left Law Enforcer—receiving envoys and resolving doubts.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》：在太微垣門內，左執法北。

translations.literal: New Book of Heavenly Appearances: within the gate of the Supreme Palace Enclosure, north of the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: The New Book of Heavenly Appearances: within the gate of the Supreme Palace Enclosure, north of the Left Law Enforcer.

translations.literal: Bright and flourishing — the four barbarians present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: When bright and flourishing, the four quarters send tribute.

sentences.zh: 三台六星，兩兩而居，起文昌，列抵太微。

translations.literal: The Three Terraces: six stars, dwelling in pairs, starting from Wenchang and arrayed reaching the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Terraces comprise six stars arranged in pairs, rising from Wenchang and running toward the Supreme Palace.

translations.literal: Also called the Pillar of Heaven — the position of the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: Also called the Pillar of Heaven—the celestial seat of the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 在人曰三公，在天曰三台，主開德宣符。

translations.literal: In humans they are called the Three Excellencies; in heaven the Three Terraces — governing the opening of virtue and proclaiming of talismans.
translations.idiomatic: On earth they are the Three Excellencies; in heaven the Three Terraces—opening virtue and proclaiming the sovereign's mandate.

sentences.zh: 西近文昌二星，曰上臺，爲司命，主壽；

translations.literal: West, near the two Wenchang stars, called the Upper Terrace — the Director of Fate, governing longevity.
translations.idiomatic: To the west, near the two Wenchang stars, stands the Upper Terrace—the Director of Fate, governing longevity.

sentences.zh: 次二星曰中台，爲司中，主宗室；

translations.literal: The next two stars called the Middle Terrace — the Director of Center, governing the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: The next pair forms the Middle Terrace—the Director of Center, governing the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 東二星曰下臺，爲司祿，主兵，所以昭德塞違也。

translations.literal: The eastern two stars called the Lower Terrace — the Director of Emolument, governing military affairs, thereby displaying virtue and blocking transgression.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern pair forms the Lower Terrace—the Director of Emolument, governing military affairs, displaying virtue and restraining wrongdoing.

sentences.zh: 又曰三台爲天階，太一躡以上下。

translations.literal: Also said the Three Terraces are the Heavenly Stairs, upon which Grand Unity treads to ascend and descend.
translations.idiomatic: They are also called the Heavenly Stairs, which Grand Unity treads in ascending and descending.

sentences.zh: 一曰泰階，上階上星爲天子，下星爲女主；

translations.literal: Also called the Grand Stairs — the upper star of the upper stair is the Son of Heaven, the lower star the chief consort.
translations.idiomatic: Also called the Grand Stairs: the upper star of the upper stair is the Son of Heaven, the lower the chief consort.

sentences.zh: 中階上星爲諸侯三公，下星爲卿大夫；

translations.literal: The upper star of the middle stair is the feudal lords and Three Excellencies, the lower star the ministers and grandees.
translations.idiomatic: The upper star of the middle stair is the feudal lords and Three Excellencies; the lower, the ministers and grandees.

sentences.zh: 下階上星爲士，下星爲庶人，所以和陰陽而理萬物也。

translations.literal: The upper star of the lower stair is the scholar-officials, the lower star the common people — thereby harmonizing yin and yang and governing all things.
translations.idiomatic: The upper star of the lower stair is the scholar-officials; the lower, the common people—thereby harmonizing yin and yang and ordering all things.

sentences.zh: 又曰上臺上星主兗、豫，下星主荊、揚；

translations.literal: Also said the upper star of the Upper Terrace governs Yan and Yu, the lower star Jing and Yang.
translations.idiomatic: The Upper Terrace's upper star governs Yan and Yu; its lower star, Jing and Yang.

sentences.zh: 中臺上星主梁、雍，下星主冀；

translations.literal: The upper star of the Middle Terrace governs Liang and Yong, the lower star Ji.
translations.idiomatic: The Middle Terrace's upper star governs Liang and Yong; its lower star, Ji.

sentences.zh: 下臺上星主青，下星主徐。

translations.literal: The upper star of the Lower Terrace governs Qing, the lower star Xu.
translations.idiomatic: The Lower Terrace's upper star governs Qing; its lower star, Xu.

sentences.zh: 人主好兵，則上階上星疏而色赤。

translations.literal: If the sovereign is fond of war, the upper star of the upper stair is sparse and red in color.
translations.idiomatic: When the sovereign loves war, the upper star of the upper stair grows sparse and turns red.

sentences.zh: 修宮廣囿，肆聲色，則上階合而橫。

translations.literal: Building palaces and broad parks, indulging in sound and sex — the upper stairs join and lie crosswise.
translations.idiomatic: When he builds palaces and pleasure grounds and indulges in music and women, the upper stairs draw together and lie crosswise.

translations.literal: If the ruler is weak, the upper stairs are pressed together and dim in color.
translations.idiomatic: When the ruler weakens, the upper stairs crowd close and their light dims.

sentences.zh: 公侯皆叛，率部動兵，則中階上星赤。

translations.literal: If dukes and marquises all rebel and lead their departments to mobilize troops, the upper star of the middle stair is red.
translations.idiomatic: When dukes and marquises rebel and raise armies, the upper star of the middle stair turns red.

sentences.zh: 外夷來侵，邊國騷動，則中階下星疏而橫，色白。

translations.literal: If outer barbarians come to invade and border states are disturbed, the lower star of the middle stair is sparse and crosswise, white in color.
translations.idiomatic: When foreign peoples invade and the borderlands are in turmoil, the lower star of the middle stair grows sparse and crosswise, turning white.

sentences.zh: 卿大夫廢正向邪，則中階下星疏而色赤。

translations.literal: If ministers and grandees abandon the correct and turn to evil, the lower star of the middle stair is sparse and red in color.
translations.idiomatic: When ministers and grandees abandon righteousness for wickedness, the lower star of the middle stair grows sparse and turns red.

sentences.zh: 民不從令，犯刑爲盜，則上階下星色黑。

translations.literal: If the people do not follow orders, violate punishments and become robbers, the lower star of the upper stair is black in color.
translations.idiomatic: When the people defy the law and turn to banditry, the lower star of the upper stair turns black.

sentences.zh: 去本就末，奢侈相尚，則下階上星闊而橫，色白。

translations.literal: Leaving the root and pursuing the tip, luxury mutually honored — the upper star of the lower stair is wide and crosswise, white in color.
translations.idiomatic: When men abandon the essential for the trivial and vie in extravagance, the upper star of the lower stair spreads wide and crosswise, turning white.

sentences.zh: 君臣有道，賦省刑清，則上階爲之戚。

translations.literal: Ruler and ministers have the Way, taxes reduced and punishments clear — the upper stairs become contracted for them.
translations.idiomatic: When ruler and ministers hold to the Way, taxes are light and justice clear—the upper stairs draw close together.

sentences.zh: 諸侯貢聘，公卿盡忠，則中階爲之比。

translations.literal: Feudal lords send tribute embassies and dukes and ministers are fully loyal — the middle stairs become close for them.
translations.idiomatic: When feudal lords send tribute and the great ministers serve with full loyalty, the middle stairs draw near one another.

sentences.zh: 庶人奉化，徭役有敘，則下階爲之密。

translations.literal: Common people accept transformation and corvée labor is orderly — the lower stairs become dense for them.
translations.idiomatic: When the common people accept the transforming influence of rule and corvée labor proceeds in order, the lower stairs grow dense.

sentences.zh: 若主奢欲，數奪民時，則上階爲之奪。

translations.literal: If the sovereign is luxurious in desire and repeatedly seizes the people's seasons, the upper stairs become seized for them.
translations.idiomatic: When the sovereign indulges his desires and repeatedly steals the people's seasons for labor, the upper stairs scatter apart.

sentences.zh: 諸侯僭強，公卿專貪，則中階爲之疏。

translations.literal: Feudal lords overstep and grow strong, dukes and ministers monopolize greed — the middle stairs become sparse for them.
translations.idiomatic: When feudal lords grow overmighty and the great ministers grow greedy, the middle stairs spread sparse.

sentences.zh: 士庶逐末，豪傑相淩，則下階爲之闊。

translations.literal: Scholar-officials and commoners pursue the tip and heroes mutually bully — the lower stairs become wide for them.
translations.idiomatic: When scholar-officials and commoners chase profit and the bold prey on one another, the lower stairs spread wide.

sentences.zh: 三階平，則陰陽和，風雨時，谷豐世泰；

translations.literal: When the three stairs are level — yin and yang are harmonized, wind and rain timely, grain abundant and the age peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: When the three stairs stand level, yin and yang harmonize, rain and wind arrive in season, grain fills the granaries, and the age knows peace.

translations.literal: If not level, the opposite.
translations.idiomatic: When they are not level, the reverse holds.

translations.literal: If the Three Terraces are not complete — all under heaven loses its plan.
translations.idiomatic: When the Three Terraces are incomplete, the realm loses its bearings.

sentences.zh: 色明齊等，君臣和而政令行；

translations.literal: Color bright and equal — ruler and ministers harmonize and government decrees are executed.
translations.idiomatic: When their color is bright and even, ruler and ministers live in harmony and edicts are obeyed.

translations.literal: Faint and fine — the opposite.
translations.idiomatic: When they are faint and uneven, the reverse holds.

sentences.zh: 一曰天柱不見，王者惡之。

translations.literal: One account: if the Pillar of Heaven is not seen — the king regards it as ill-omened.
translations.idiomatic: One account holds that if the Pillar of Heaven vanishes from sight, the sovereign takes it as a dire omen.

translations.literal: If the Director of Fate star vanishes — in spring one cannot plow.
translations.idiomatic: When the Director of Fate star vanishes, spring brings no plowing.

translations.literal: If the Director of Center is not complete — in summer one cannot weed.
translations.idiomatic: When the Director of Center is incomplete, summer brings no hoeing.

translations.literal: If the Director of Emolument is not complete — in autumn one cannot harvest.
translations.idiomatic: When the Director of Emolument is incomplete, autumn brings no harvest.

translations.literal: One account: if the Three Terraces are green in color — pestilence under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: One account holds that when the Three Terraces turn green, pestilence spreads under heaven.

translations.literal: Red — war.
translations.idiomatic: Red portends war.

translations.literal: Yellow and lustrous — virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow and lustrous portends virtue.

translations.literal: White — mourning.
translations.idiomatic: White portends mourning.

translations.literal: Black — worry.
translations.idiomatic: Black portends trouble.

translations.literal: When the Moon enters — the ruler is troubled, ministers fall into disorder, and the ducal clan rebels.
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon enters, the sovereign is in distress, ministers rebel, and the imperial clan turns traitor.

translations.literal: When the Moon enters and halos — the Three Excellencies are cast into prison.
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon enters and a halo rings it, the Three Excellencies are thrown into prison.

translations.literal: When a guest star enters them — noble ministers receive bestowed ranks and fiefs.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star enters them, noble ministers receive ranks and fiefs.

translations.literal: Exiting and pale in color — ministers are stripped of rank.
translations.idiomatic: When it exits, wan and ashen, ministers are stripped of their ranks.

sentences.zh: 守之，大臣黜，或貴臣多病。

translations.literal: Stationing itself there — great ministers are dismissed, or noble ministers suffer many illnesses.
translations.idiomatic: When it stations itself there, high ministers are dismissed—or noble ministers fall gravely ill.

translations.literal: When a comet transgresses — the Three Excellencies are dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet transgresses them, the Three Excellencies are removed from office.

translations.literal: When a meteor enters — military generals under heaven are troubled.
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor enters, generals throughout the realm are in distress.

sentences.zh: 抵中台，將相憂，人主惡之。

translations.literal: Reaching the Middle Terrace — generals and chancellors are troubled, and the sovereign regards it as ill-omened.
translations.idiomatic: When it reaches the Middle Terrace, generals and chancellors are in distress and the sovereign takes it as a dire omen.

translations.literal: Cloud vapor entering, pale white — many among the people are wounded.
translations.idiomatic: When pale white cloud vapor enters, many among the people suffer harm.

translations.literal: Yellow-white and lustrous — the people are secure and the ruler rejoices.
translations.idiomatic: When yellow-white cloud vapor enters, lustrous and bright, the people live in peace and the sovereign rejoices.

translations.literal: Yellow — generals and chancellors rejoice.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow portends joy for generals and chancellors.

translations.literal: Red — worry.
translations.idiomatic: Red portends trouble.

translations.literal: Green-black — worry lies with the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: Green-black portends trouble for the Three Excellencies.

translations.literal: Pale white — the Three Excellencies are dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Pale white portends the dismissal of the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 按上臺二星在柳北，其北星入柳六度。

translations.literal: According to investigation, the two Upper Terrace stars are north of Willow; their northern star enters Willow six degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The two Upper Terrace stars lie north of Willow; their northern star stands six degrees into Willow.

sentences.zh: 中台二星，其北入張二度。

translations.literal: The two Middle Terrace stars — their northern star enters Extended Net two degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The two Middle Terrace stars: their northern star stands two degrees into Extended Net.

sentences.zh: 下臺二星在太微垣西蕃北，其北星入翼二度。

translations.literal: The two Lower Terrace stars are north of the western rampart of the Supreme Palace Enclosure; their northern star enters Wings two degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The two Lower Terrace stars lie north of the western rampart of the Supreme Palace Enclosure; their northern star stands two degrees into Wings.

sentences.zh: 武密書：三臺屬鬼，又屬柳、屬張。

translations.literal: Wu Mi's book: the Three Terraces belong to Ghost, and also belong to Willow and Extended Net.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi's book assigns the Three Terraces to Ghost, and also to Willow and Extended Net.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》：上臺屬柳，中臺屬張，下臺屬翼。

translations.literal: New Book of Heavenly Appearances: the Upper Terrace belongs to Willow, the Middle Terrace to Extended Net, the Lower Terrace to Wings.
translations.idiomatic: The New Book of Heavenly Appearances assigns the Upper Terrace to Willow, the Middle Terrace to Extended Net, and the Lower Terrace to Wings.

sentences.zh: 長垣四星，在少微星南，主界域，及北方。

translations.literal: The Long Rampart: four stars south of the Lesser Microcosm stars — governs boundaries and the north.
translations.idiomatic: The Long Rampart comprises four stars south of the Lesser Microcosm—governing the borderlands and the north.

translations.literal: When the Sparkling Deluder enters them — northerners enter the Middle Kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: When Mars enters them, northerners invade the Middle Kingdom.

translations.literal: When the Great White enters — the Nine Ministers plot and border generals rebel.
translations.idiomatic: When Venus enters, the Nine Ministers conspire and border generals rebel.

translations.literal: When a comet or broom star transgresses them — the northern lands are not secure.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet or broom star transgresses them, the northern frontier falls into turmoil.

sentences.zh: 流星入，北方兵起，將入中國。

translations.literal: When a meteor enters — war rises in the north and will enter the Middle Kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor enters, war breaks out in the north and will sweep into the Middle Kingdom.

sentences.zh: 少微四星，在太微西，士大夫之位也。

translations.literal: The Lesser Microcosm: four stars west of the Supreme Palace — the position of scholar-officials.
translations.idiomatic: The Lesser Microcosm comprises four stars west of the Supreme Palace—the seat of scholar-officials.

sentences.zh: 一名處士，亦天子副主，或曰博士官，一曰主衛掖門。

translations.literal: One name Recluse; also the Son of Heaven's deputy master, or said the Doctorate office; one account governs guarding the side-gates.
translations.idiomatic: Also called the Recluse; the Son of Heaven's deputy sovereign, or the seat of the Doctorate; by one account it governs the guarding of the side-gates.

sentences.zh: 南第一星處士，第二星議士，第三星博士，第四星大夫。

translations.literal: The southern first star is the Recluse, the second the Discussion Scholar, the third the Doctor, the fourth the Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: The southernmost star is the Recluse; the second, the Discussion Scholar; the third, the Doctor; the fourth, the Grandee.

translations.literal: When bright, large, and yellow, worthy scholars are promoted.
translations.idiomatic: When the stars shine bright, large, and yellow, worthy scholars are raised up.

sentences.zh: 月五星犯守處士，女主憂，宰相易。

translations.literal: When the Moon and Five Planets transgress or station upon the Recluse, the empress is troubled and the chancellor is replaced.
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon or the Five Planets transgress or station upon the Recluse, the empress faces trouble and the chancellor is replaced.

translations.literal: When Jupiter transgresses, petty men are employed and loyal ministers are endangered.
translations.idiomatic: When Jupiter transgresses it, petty men are put to use and loyal ministers fall into peril.

translations.literal: When Mars transgresses, the virtuous and worthy withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: When Mars transgresses it, the virtuous and worthy withdraw from office.

translations.literal: When Saturn transgresses, the chancellor is replaced and the empress is troubled.
translations.idiomatic: When Saturn transgresses it, the chancellor is replaced and the empress is troubled.

sentences.zh: 金犯，大臣誅，又曰以所居主占之。

translations.literal: When Venus transgresses, great ministers are executed; another account says: interpret the omen according to the star upon which it stations itself.
translations.idiomatic: When Venus transgresses it, great ministers are executed; another account says the omen should be read according to whichever star it stations upon.

sentences.zh: 客星、孛星犯之，王者憂，奸臣衆。

translations.literal: When a guest star or broom star transgresses them, the king is troubled and treacherous ministers multiply.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star or broom star transgresses them, the king is troubled and treacherous ministers multiply.

sentences.zh: 彗星犯，功臣有罪，一曰法令臣誅。

translations.literal: When a comet transgresses, meritorious ministers are guilty; one account says officials of law and ordinance are executed.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet transgresses them, meritorious ministers are found guilty; one account says officials charged with law and ordinance are executed.

translations.literal: When a meteor issues forth, the worthy and good advance and practitioners of the Way are employed.
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor issues forth, the worthy and good are promoted and masters of the Way are put to use.

sentences.zh: 雲氣入，色蒼白，賢士憂，大臣黜。

translations.literal: When cloud vapor enters, in pale color, scholars are troubled and great ministers are dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: When pale cloud vapor enters, scholars are troubled and great ministers are dismissed.

sentences.zh: 靈台三星，在明堂西，神之精明曰靈，四方而高曰台，主觀雲物，察符瑞，候災變也。

translations.literal: Spirit Tower: three stars, west of the Bright Hall. The numen's clear brilliance is called 'spirit'; square and lofty is called 'tower.' They govern observing cloud forms, discerning portents and auspicious signs, and watching for calamities and changes.
translations.idiomatic: The Spirit Tower comprises three stars west of the Bright Hall. A numen's clear brilliance is called 'spirit'; square and lofty is called 'tower.' These stars govern the observation of cloud forms, the discernment of portents and auspicious signs, and the watching for calamities and change.

translations.literal: Wumi says: the same prognostication as Overseer of Prodigies.
translations.idiomatic: Wumi says: the prognostication is the same as that for the Overseer of Prodigies.

sentences.zh: 虎賁一星，在下臺星南，一曰在太微西蕃北、下臺南，靜室旄頭之騎官也。

translations.literal: Tiger Guard: one star, south of the Lower Terrace star; one account places it north of the western rampart of the Supreme Palace, south of the Lower Terrace—the riding officer of the Quiet Chamber and Banner Head.
translations.idiomatic: The Tiger Guard is a single star south of the Lower Terrace star—or, by one account, north of the western rampart of the Supreme Palace and south of the Lower Terrace. It is the riding officer of the Quiet Chamber and Banner Head.

sentences.zh: 明，則臣順，與車騎星同占。

translations.literal: When bright, ministers are obedient; the same prognostication as the Chariots and Cavalry star.
translations.idiomatic: When bright, ministers are obedient; the reading is the same as for the Chariots and Cavalry star.

sentences.zh: 明堂三星，在太微西南角外，天子布政之宮。

translations.literal: Bright Hall: three stars, outside the southwest corner of the Supreme Palace—the palace where the Son of Heaven promulgates government.
translations.idiomatic: The Bright Hall comprises three stars outside the southwest corner of the Supreme Palace—the palace where the Son of Heaven promulgates government.

translations.literal: Bright is auspicious; dim is inauspicious.
translations.idiomatic: When bright, the omen is auspicious; when dim, inauspicious.

sentences.zh: 五星、客星及彗犯之，主不安其宮。

translations.literal: When the Five Planets, guest stars, or comets transgress them, the sovereign does not dwell securely in his palace.
translations.idiomatic: When the Five Planets, guest stars, or comets transgress them, the sovereign cannot dwell securely in his palace.

sentences.zh: 右上元太微宮常星一十九坐，積數七十有八，而《晉志》所載，少微、長垣各四星，屬天市垣，與《步天歌》不同。

translations.literal: Above right: within the Supreme Palace Enclosure there are nineteen named regular asterisms, totaling seventy-eight stars. Yet the Jin Treatise places the four stars each of Lesser Subtlety and Long Rampart within the Celestial Market Enclosure—differing from the Song of Pacing Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Above right: within the Supreme Palace Enclosure there are nineteen named regular asterisms, totaling seventy-eight stars. Yet the Jin Treatise places the four stars each of Lesser Subtlety and Long Rampart within the Celestial Market Enclosure—differing from the Song of Pacing Heaven.

translations.literal: The Celestial Market Enclosure
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Market Enclosure

sentences.zh: 天市垣二十二星，在氐、房、心、尾、箕、鬥內宮之內。

translations.literal: The Celestial Market Enclosure comprises twenty-two stars, within the Inner Palace of Root, Room, Heart, Tail, Winnowing Basket, and Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Market Enclosure comprises twenty-two stars within the Inner Palace of Root, Room, Heart, Tail, Winnowing Basket, and Dipper.

sentences.zh: 東蕃十一星：南一曰宋，二曰南海，三曰燕，四曰東海，五曰徐，六曰吳越，七曰齊，八曰中山，九曰九河，十曰趙，十一曰魏。

translations.literal: Eastern rampart, eleven stars: from the south, the first is Song; the second, South Sea; the third, Yan; the fourth, East Sea; the fifth, Xu; the sixth, Wu and Yue; the seventh, Qi; the eighth, Zhongshan; the ninth, Nine Rivers; the tenth, Zhao; the eleventh, Wei.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern rampart has eleven stars: from the south, the first is Song; the second, South Sea; the third, Yan; the fourth, East Sea; the fifth, Xu; the sixth, Wu and Yue; the seventh, Qi; the eighth, Zhongshan; the ninth, Nine Rivers; the tenth, Zhao; the eleventh, Wei.

sentences.zh: 西蕃十一星：南一曰韓，二曰楚，三曰梁，四曰巴，五曰蜀，六曰秦，七曰周，八曰鄭，九曰晉，十曰河間，十一曰河中。

translations.literal: Western rampart, eleven stars: from the south, the first is Han; the second, Chu; the third, Liang; the fourth, Ba; the fifth, Shu; the sixth, Qin; the seventh, Zhou; the eighth, Zheng; the ninth, Jin; the tenth, Hejian; the eleventh, Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: The western rampart has eleven stars: from the south, the first is Han; the second, Chu; the third, Liang; the fourth, Ba; the fifth, Shu; the sixth, Qin; the seventh, Zhou; the eighth, Zheng; the ninth, Jin; the tenth, Hejian; the eleventh, Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 象天王在上，諸侯朝王，王出皋門大朝會，西方諸侯在應門左，東方諸侯在應門右。

translations.literal: It represents the Celestial King above and feudal lords attending upon the king. When the king exits the Gaomen Gate for a great court assembly, western feudal lords stand to the left of the Ying Gate and eastern feudal lords to the right.
translations.idiomatic: It represents the Celestial King above and the feudal lords attending upon the king. When the king exits the Gaomen Gate for a great court assembly, the western feudal lords stand to the left of the Ying Gate and the eastern feudal lords to the right.

sentences.zh: 其率諸侯幸都市也亦然。

translations.literal: So too when he leads the feudal lords to visit the capital market.
translations.idiomatic: The same arrangement holds when he leads the feudal lords to visit the capital market.

sentences.zh: 一曰在房、心東北，主權衡，主聚衆。

translations.literal: One account places it northeast of Room and Heart. It governs scales and balance, and governs gathering the multitude.
translations.idiomatic: One account places it northeast of Room and Heart. It governs scales and balance and the gathering of the multitude.

translations.literal: It is also called the Celestial Banner Court, governing executions and slaughter.
translations.idiomatic: It is also called the Celestial Banner Court and governs executions and slaughter.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》曰：市中星衆潤澤，則歲實。

translations.literal: The New Book of Heavenly Images says: when the stars within the market are many and lustrous, the year yields abundantly.
translations.idiomatic: The New Book of Heavenly Images says: when the stars within the market are many and lustrous, the year yields abundantly.

translations.literal: When Mars stations itself there, disloyal ministers are executed.
translations.idiomatic: When Mars stations itself there, disloyal ministers are executed.

translations.literal: When a comet sweeps across it, the capital market is relocated and the capital moved.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet sweeps across it, the market is relocated and the capital is moved.

translations.literal: When a guest star enters, war arises;
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star enters, war arises;

translations.literal: when it exits, nobles die.
translations.idiomatic: when it exits, nobles die.

sentences.zh: 《天文錄》曰：天子之市，天下所會也。

translations.literal: The Record of Astronomy says: the Son of Heaven's market is where all under Heaven gathers.
translations.idiomatic: The Record of Astronomy says: the Son of Heaven's market is where all under Heaven gathers.

sentences.zh: 星明大，則市吏急，商人無利；

translations.literal: When the stars are bright and large, market officials grow harsh and merchants gain no profit;
translations.idiomatic: When the stars are bright and large, market officials grow harsh and merchants gain no profit;

translations.literal: when small, the opposite;
translations.idiomatic: when small, the opposite holds;

translations.literal: when they suddenly grow dim, grain grows costly;
translations.idiomatic: when they suddenly grow dim, grain grows costly;

translations.literal: when many small stars appear among them, the people grow wealthy.
translations.idiomatic: when many small stars appear among them, the people grow wealthy.

sentences.zh: 月入天市，易政更弊，近臣有抵罪，兵起。

translations.literal: When the Moon enters the Celestial Market, government changes and abuses are reformed, close ministers face punishment, and war arises.
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon enters the Celestial Market, government changes, abuses are reformed, close ministers face punishment, and war arises.

sentences.zh: 月守其中，女主憂，大臣災。

translations.literal: When the Moon stations itself within it, the empress is troubled and great ministers face calamity.
translations.idiomatic: When the Moon stations itself within it, the empress is troubled and great ministers face calamity.

translations.literal: When the Five Planets enter, generals and chancellors are troubled and the Five Officials face calamity;
translations.idiomatic: When the Five Planets enter, generals and chancellors are troubled and the Five Officials face calamity;

translations.literal: stationing itself there means the market is alarmed and abuses are reformed.
translations.idiomatic: when one stations itself there, the market is alarmed and abuses are reformed.

translations.literal: Another account says: when the Five Planets enter, war arises.
translations.idiomatic: Another account says: when the Five Planets enter, war arises.

translations.literal: When Mars stations itself there, great famine and fire disaster follow.
translations.idiomatic: When Mars stations itself there, great famine and fire disaster follow.

sentences.zh: 或芒角色赤如血，市臣叛。

translations.literal: Sometimes its rays and horns turn red as blood—the market officials rebel.
translations.idiomatic: Sometimes its rays and horns turn red as blood, and the market officials rebel.

translations.literal: When Saturn stations itself there, grain grows costly.
translations.idiomatic: When Saturn stations itself there, grain grows costly.

translations.literal: When Venus enters, armies are raised and grain grows costly.
translations.idiomatic: When Venus enters, armies are raised and grain grows costly.

translations.literal: When Mercury stations itself there, barbarian chieftains die.
translations.idiomatic: When Mercury stations itself there, barbarian chieftains die.

translations.literal: When a guest star stations itself there, weights and measures are unjust;
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star stations itself there, weights and measures are unjust;

translations.literal: when the star is white, the market falls into chaos;
translations.idiomatic: when the star is white, the market falls into chaos;

translations.literal: when it exits the Celestial Market, mourning follows.
translations.idiomatic: when it exits the Celestial Market, mourning follows.

translations.literal: When a comet stations itself there, grain grows costly;
translations.idiomatic: When a comet stations itself there, grain grows costly;

sentences.zh: 出天市，豪傑起，徙易市都；

translations.literal: when it exits the Celestial Market, heroes rise up and the market and capital are relocated;
translations.idiomatic: when it exits the Celestial Market, heroes rise up and the market and capital are relocated;

sentences.zh: 掃帝坐，出天市，除舊佈新。

translations.literal: sweeping the Emperor's Seat and exiting the Celestial Market—eliminating the old and spreading the new.
translations.idiomatic: sweeping the Emperor's Seat and exiting the Celestial Market means eliminating the old and spreading the new.
